title: SkillForge: Forging Domain-Specific, Self-Evolving Agent Skills in Cloud Technical Support
problem: Domain-specific support skills stagnate because execution failures are not traced back to actionable skill deficiencies.
assumption_broken: Expert-authored or initially generated skills need not remain fixed after deployment.
operational_signature: Ground → execute → aggregate failures → diagnose → rewrite
load_bearing_mechanism: Batch failure attribution maps recurring execution errors to specific skill sections for targeted rewriting.
limitations_evident: Knowledge failures plateau after initial refinement
Historical expert references can conflict
Evaluation restricted to mature cloud-support scenarios

title: SEA-Eval: A Benchmark for Evaluating Self-Evolving Agents Beyond Episodic Assessment
problem: Episodic success-rate evaluation cannot distinguish persistent experience reuse from expensive repeated reasoning.
assumption_broken: Comparable task success does not imply comparable evolutionary capability.
operational_signature: Execute → distill → retain → reuse → measure convergence
load_bearing_mechanism: Sequential task streams expose whether persistent experience reduces execution cost while maintaining success.
limitations_evident: Only 32 atomic tasks
Autonomous bootstrapping is not evaluated
Subjective preferences remain difficult to assess

title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering
problem: Static or pass-rate-only skill engineering neglects inference cost and misleading guidance.
assumption_broken: Adding skill guidance is not necessarily better than pruning or substituting it.
operational_signature: Sample bundles → execute → propose edits → evaluate → select tradeoffs
load_bearing_mechanism: NSGA-II preserves skill bundles on a pass-rate versus inference-cost Pareto frontier.
limitations_evident: Single model and benchmark
Selection and reporting use task-specific verifiers
Edit-pattern analysis is descriptive rather than causal

title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
problem: Static pipeline benchmarks do not test autonomous engineering of interactive RL post-training loops.
assumption_broken: Successful supervised post-training or a high final score does not establish online-RL engineering capability.
operational_signature: Inspect → implement → train → submit → diagnose → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: A fixed-budget isolated workspace and repeated grading require agents to produce executable training pipelines and model artifacts.
limitations_evident: Single runs in the controlled 8B study
Repeated grading permits adaptive overfitting
Full-stack outcomes entangle multiple capabilities

title: Mem$^2$Evolve: Towards Self-Evolving Agents via Co-Evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation
problem: Experience-only evolution cannot expand a fixed toolset while unguided asset generation repeats mistakes.
assumption_broken: Capability creation and experience accumulation need not be separate evolutionary processes.
operational_signature: Retrieve → create missing capabilities → execute → validate → distill → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Dual asset and experience memories let distilled lessons guide validated tool and expert creation.

improver_modified.how: Accumulated tool-creation experience conditions subsequent asset generation and debugging.

limitations_evident: Sandbox dependency restricts deployment
Single backbone evaluation
Self-generated validation need not establish general reliability

title: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation
problem: Generating editable articulated assemblies is hindered by spatial reasoning errors and coupled design-code failures.
assumption_broken: Assembly relationships need not be inferred after independent part geometry has been generated.
operational_signature: Plan interfaces → generate components → align → inspect → route repairs → retain experience
load_bearing_mechanism: Early connector contracts turn assembly into deterministic frame alignment and enable localized rollback.
limitations_evident: Kinematic trees exclude closed chains
Dependent on foundation-model reasoning
Open-ended assemblies primarily evaluated by VLM judges

title: Self-Evolving LLM Memory Extraction Across Heterogeneous Tasks
problem: Heterogeneous extraction feedback makes prompt updates unstable or washes out scenario-specific lessons.
assumption_broken: A homogeneous batch-analysis strategy is not sufficient for optimizing a general memory extractor.
operational_signature: Extract → score utility → summarize scenarios → cluster → analyze → synthesize updates
load_bearing_mechanism: Cluster-local analysis preserves distinct extraction needs before cross-cluster prompt synthesis.
limitations_evident: Main protocol isolates single-step extraction
Full memory lifecycle not optimized
Continual analysis selects two favorable tasks

title: M$^\star$: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness
problem: Fixed memory harnesses encode assumptions that transfer poorly between task domains.
assumption_broken: Memory schema, executable logic, and usage instructions can be searched jointly instead of fixed by designers.
operational_signature: Sample parent → execute → inspect failures → patch → validate → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Reflective population-based evolution jointly optimizes executable memory structure and agent interaction policy.
limitations_evident: Most transferred programs underperform a universal seed
Aggregate optimization leaves some categories underserved
Program evaluation requires rebuilding memory

title: Thought-Retriever: Don't Just Retrieve Raw Data, Retrieve Thoughts for Memory-Augmented Agentic Systems
problem: Retrieving a fixed number of raw chunks limits knowledge coverage within a bounded context window.
assumption_broken: Reusable retrieval units need not be raw chunks or query-independent static summaries.
operational_signature: Retrieve → answer → abstract → check confidence and novelty → store → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Query-conditioned abstractions are retained only when self-rated meaningful and nonredundant, enabling deeper future retrieval.
limitations_evident: English-only evaluation
AcademicEval emphasizes AI papers
Extreme-scale robustness remains untested

title: Frontier-Eng: Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on Real-World Engineering Tasks with Generative Optimization
problem: Binary correctness benchmarks miss constrained iterative optimization of already feasible engineering artifacts.
assumption_broken: Engineering progress should be measured by continuous feasible improvement rather than one-shot correctness.
operational_signature: Initialize → propose → execute verifier → compare → retain → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Frozen executable engineering verifiers provide continuous rewards and hard constraints under a fixed search budget.
limitations_evident: Model rankings shift materially after a retest
Complex physical tradeoffs remain difficult
Optimization evaluates fixed problem instances
closest_prior: Learning to Discover at Test Time

title: Evolvable Embodied Agent for Robotic Manipulation via Long Short-Term Reflection and Optimization
problem: Robotic agents struggle to extract generalizable corrective lessons from task outcomes without retraining.
assumption_broken: Reflections should not all be reused indiscriminately across tasks.
operational_signature: Interpret → plan → execute → locate errors → reflect → consolidate
load_bearing_mechanism: Generalized long-term principles and task-specific short-term suggestions are updated separately after localized feedback.
limitations_evident: Only six simulated manipulation tasks
Strong dependence on segmentation quality
Long-term and short-term knowledge can overlap

title: MUSE: Multi-Domain Chinese User Simulation via Self-Evolving Profiles and Rubric-Guided Alignment
problem: Shallow user profiles and local imitation fail to maintain realistic persona-consistent behavior over dialogue.
assumption_broken: One-pass profile extraction and utterance-level realism are insufficient for long-horizon user simulation.
operational_signature: Extract profile → reconstruct dialogue → compare behavior → rewrite → imitate → align
load_bearing_mechanism: Discrepancy-aware profile refinement supplies richer conditioning for role-reversal training and rubric-guided multi-turn RL.
limitations_evident: Chinese dialogue from six domains only
Longer open-ended interactions untested
Expert and LLM evaluation can encode biases

title: Memory Transfer Learning: How Memories are Transferred Across Domains in Coding Agents
problem: Single-domain memory silos discard reusable coding practices shared across heterogeneous tasks.
assumption_broken: Memories from other coding domains can be useful when abstracted beyond implementation details.
operational_signature: Collect trajectories → judge outcomes → abstract → pool across domains → retrieve → execute
load_bearing_mechanism: Abstract insight memories transfer procedural meta-knowledge without anchoring agents to unrelated code details.
limitations_evident: Low-level memories risk negative transfer
At most 100 tasks sampled per benchmark
Pass@3 does not report seed variance

title: SpaceMind: A Modular and Self-Evolving Embodied Vision-Language Agent Framework for Autonomous On-orbit Servicing
problem: Space-operation agents lack persistent failure-derived knowledge and portable modular interfaces.
assumption_broken: Operational knowledge can evolve through persistent skill files without changing model weights.
operational_signature: Route skills → perceive → act → reflect → quality-check → inject learned skills
load_bearing_mechanism: Episode reflection produces deduplicated task-bound learned skills that correct recurring execution failures.
limitations_evident: Task binding prevents cross-task skill transfer
Only 18 laboratory runs
Little benefit when baseline already succeeds

title: Evo-MedAgent: Beyond One-Shot Diagnosis with Agents That Remember, Reflect, and Improve
problem: Medical agents repeat diagnostic and tool-use mistakes because they solve each case without accumulated experience.
assumption_broken: Frozen medical models can improve across cases through structured memory rather than retraining or more tools.
operational_signature: Retrieve precedents → diagnose → reveal feedback → reflect → patch policies → update trust
load_bearing_mechanism: Ground-truth-conditioned reflection updates complementary episodic precedents and reusable priority-tagged diagnostic rules.
limitations_evident: Assumes immediate ground-truth feedback
Tool-governance component lacks quantitative ablation
Only chest X-ray qualitative reasoning studied

title: Discovering Novel LLM Experts via Task-Capability Coevolution
problem: Static datasets and single-model training limit continual discovery of diverse complementary capabilities.
assumption_broken: Capability development need not optimize one model against a fixed benchmark objective.
operational_signature: Merge models → score skills → preserve diversity → adapt tasks → validate → coevolve
load_bearing_mechanism: Diversity-selected model archives coevolve with difficulty-adapted synthetic tasks to expose complementary expertise.
limitations_evident: Seeds must share a base architecture
Fixed scientist limits exploration
Coverage gains exceed practical best-of-N gains

title: SAGER: Self-Evolving User Policy Skills for Recommendation Agent
problem: Recommendation agents update user facts but retain a universal reasoning policy that repeats personalized decision errors.
assumption_broken: Personalization can change per-user reasoning principles rather than only remembered preferences.
operational_signature: Retrieve → distill policy → rank jointly → contrast choices → refine confidence
load_bearing_mechanism: Incremental contrastive updates preserve a rich policy substrate while injecting only a compact high-confidence skill.
limitations_evident: Inference uses only ten sampled candidates
Sparse metadata weakens initialization
Injection boundary may depend on model

title: Autogenesis: A Self-Evolving Agent Protocol
problem: Heterogeneous runtime updates lack a common auditable lifecycle for candidate assessment, acceptance, and version retention.
assumption_broken: The resource being evolved can be managed independently from the strategy proposing changes.
operational_signature: Register → execute → reflect → propose → assess → commit
load_bearing_mechanism: A shared resource protocol separates inactive candidate evaluation from versioned publication and consumer binding.
limitations_evident: No equal-cost superiority established
Restoration cannot undo external actions
Recovery after faulty activation not evaluated

title: Autonomous Evolution of EDA Tools: Multi-Agent Self-Evolved ABC
problem: Large interconnected synthesis codebases make manual heuristic integration and improvement expensive.
assumption_broken: An entire integrated synthesis tool can be evolved rather than only isolated algorithmic kernels.
operational_signature: Profile → plan subsystem edits → compile → check equivalence → score → retain
load_bearing_mechanism: Subsystem-specialized coding agents accumulate QoR-improving edits behind compilation and functional-equivalence gates.
limitations_evident: Requires substantial domain scaffolding
Novel algorithmic constructs fail more often
Full iteration uses 87 CPU nodes for hours

title: From Procedural Skills to Strategy Genes: Towards Experience-Driven Test-Time Evolution
problem: Documentation-heavy experience packages dilute actionable guidance and support unstable test-time control.
assumption_broken: More complete procedural documentation is not necessarily a better reusable experience representation.
operational_signature: Distill experience → structure strategy → inject → execute → compress failure warnings → revise
load_bearing_mechanism: Compact editable strategy genes concentrate actionable steps and failure-aware warnings rather than appending documentation.
limitations_evident: Only two CritPt evolutionary runs
Retained-trial filtering not explained in excerpt
Representation tests emphasize scientific Python tasks

title: EvoRAG: Making Knowledge Graph-based RAG Automatically Evolve through Feedback Backpropagation
problem: Response-level feedback is too coarse to directly refine task-relevant knowledge graph triplets.
assumption_broken: Knowledge graph usefulness should be learned from downstream outcomes rather than judged only by factual plausibility.
operational_signature: Retrieve paths → generate → score response → attribute utility → propagate → reshape graph
load_bearing_mechanism: Path-level utility attribution propagates feedback to triplet contribution scores that control suppression, shortcut fusion, and retrieval.
limitations_evident: Training neighborhoods are derived from test queries
Relies on LLM path attribution
Evaluation simulates localized graph hotspots

title: Harnessing Pre-Resolution Signals for Future Prediction Agents
problem: Forecast outcomes arrive too late and too coarsely to guide procedural improvement while a question remains unresolved.
assumption_broken: Useful adaptation signals can be extracted before ground-truth outcomes become available.
operational_signature: Forecast → compare temporal notes → diagnose → patch typed guidance → revisit → audit
load_bearing_mechanism: Bounded question-local harness updates convert temporal evidence contrasts into reusable tracking, verification, and uncertainty guidance.
limitations_evident: Adaptation remains within one unresolved question
Cross-question reuse not quantified
Main baselines are frozen while Milkyway adapts

title: CoEvolve: Training LLM Agents via Agent-Data Mutual Evolution
problem: Static RL task distributions fail to track changing agent weaknesses and underexplored interactions.
assumption_broken: Synthetic training data should adapt to observed policy behavior rather than be generated once or explored randomly.
operational_signature: Roll out → detect weaknesses → re-explore → synthesize tasks → validate → train
load_bearing_mechanism: Forgetting, boundary, and rare-pattern signals direct executable task synthesis toward current policy weaknesses.
limitations_evident: Early low-competence feedback can be noisy
Only three weakness signal types
Safety-critical task admission lacks explicit filters

title: Software Self-Extension with SelfEvolve: an Agentic Architecture for Runtime Code Generation
problem: Conventional adaptive software reconfigures existing functions but cannot integrate new user-requested capabilities at runtime.
assumption_broken: New functions can be generated, verified, and activated without developer intervention or restart.
operational_signature: Dispatch → specify → generate tests → synthesize → validate → hot-load
load_bearing_mechanism: A deterministic two-stage test-and-adjudication loop promotes verified generated functions into a persistent reusable tool repository.
limitations_evident: Only 11 extension tasks
Adds functions rather than structural refactoring
Generated test counts lack formal coverage targets

title: MEMRES: A Memory-Augmented Resolver with Confidence Cascade for Agentic Python Dependency Resolution
problem: Dependency resolvers waste LLM inference on deterministic import, interpreter, and build compatibility failures.
assumption_broken: An LLM should be a last resort rather than the default dependency-resolution mechanism.
operational_signature: Match memory → consult maps → apply heuristics → infer if needed → build → cache validated fixes
load_bearing_mechanism: A confidence cascade reuses sandbox-validated resolution patterns before invoking the LLM.
limitations_evident: Comparison uses published PLLM baseline
Session memory is order-dependent
Heavy C-extension builds dominate failures

title: GenericAgent: A Token-Efficient Self-Evolving LLM Agent via Contextual Information Density Maximization (V1.0)
problem: Long-running agents bury decision-relevant information in growing context and repeatedly lose useful experience.
assumption_broken: More context and more specialized tools need not produce better agent performance.
operational_signature: Execute → verify → distill → index → retrieve on demand → reuse
load_bearing_mechanism: Verified trajectories become compact procedures and executable assets exposed through an on-demand memory hierarchy.
limitations_evident: Condensed evaluation omits self-evolution experiment details
Density principle is partly supported by practice rather than controlled ablations
Compression can omit decision-critical details

title: Beyond Meta-Reasoning: Metacognitive Consolidation for Self-Improving LLM Reasoning
problem: Episodic meta-reasoning repeatedly incurs the same correction costs without retaining reusable control knowledge.
assumption_broken: Monitoring and control policies can improve across reasoning instances rather than remaining fixed inference routines.
operational_signature: Reason → audit → intervene → distill → consolidate → condition subsequent roles
load_bearing_mechanism: Role-attributed traces are consolidated at instance, batch, and global timescales into bounded role-specific policy knowledge.

improver_modified.how: Consolidated experience updates the Monitor and Controller policies as well as the Reasoner policy.

limitations_evident: Knowledge remains benchmark-specific
Repeated benchmark passes complicate unseen-instance interpretation
Multi-role reasoning and consolidation add inference overhead

title: EvoMaster: A Foundational Evolving Agent Framework for Agentic Science at Scale
problem: Scientific agents repeatedly rebuild infrastructure and lose evidence between runs and studies.
assumption_broken: Autonomous execution alone is insufficient unless external evidence changes persistent research decisions.
operational_signature: Propose → execute → evaluate → retain → distill → accumulate
load_bearing_mechanism: Nested execution, exploration, and evolution loops promote externally grounded evidence into persistent study state and reusable capabilities.
limitations_evident: Benchmark breadth does not isolate cross-study capability transfer
Candidate selection depends on benchmark-specific evaluators
Mean cost is skewed by expensive optimization tasks

title: AutoVQA-G: Self-Improving Agentic Framework for Automated Visual Question Answering and Grounding Annotation
problem: Single-pass visual annotation hallucinates and heuristic verifiers fail to diagnose inconsistent grounding.
assumption_broken: Annotation rubrics can be adapted from visual critiques rather than fixed before generation.
operational_signature: Generate → verify → diagnose → route → rewrite → regenerate
load_bearing_mechanism: A memory-augmented optimizer routes fine-grained visual consistency critiques to targeted generation-rubric updates.
limitations_evident: Iterative system compared mainly with single-pass generators
Verifier favors less ambiguous queries
Additional verification and optimization overhead

title: SkillGraph: Self-Evolving Multi-Agent Collaboration with Multimodal Graph Topology
problem: Fixed collaboration graphs cannot exploit changing visual task demands or evolving agent expertise.
assumption_broken: Agent skills and communication topology should not be designed independently and frozen before inference.
operational_signature: Retrieve → encode → route → solve → diagnose → refine → re-encode
load_bearing_mechanism: Updated skill embeddings feed directly into a multimodal topology predictor so routing adapts to capability changes.
limitations_evident: Candidate edges are restricted by structural priors and acyclicity
Gains diminish on stronger backbones and OCR-heavy tasks
Condensed text does not establish independent evaluation splits
